answer.text: The manual recommends shifting up from 2nd to 3rd gear at 30 km/h.

watchouts.text: Releasing the clutch abruptly while accelerating hard can make the motorcycle move suddenly, causing loss of control, an accident, injury or death, and damage to the motorcycle.
Releasing the clutch abruptly with insufficient throttle opening causes a rough start and can stall the engine.
Use utmost caution while releasing the clutch and riding the motorcycle.

watchout_review.reason: Abrupt clutch release with low throttle causes a rough start and stalling during shifts.
Abrupt clutch release at high acceleration can cause loss of control and injury.
General caution when releasing the clutch, relevant to the shift.
Continuation of the caution in E8 about riding the motorcycle.
Repeats the recommended speed already given in the answer.
